textRuns.value: 35% return rate + 25% active-day consistency + 25% prompt intensity + 15% advanced delegation.
return rate; active days / 3; prompts per active user / 12; and Rung 3+ users / active users. Each component is capped at 100%, then weighted and rounded to a 0–100 score.

0 means no momentum signals; 100 means all four reach their caps. Compare a department with itself across several weeks—not as a performance grade. Blank = no active users or weights not totaling 100%. Learn more or change defaults on Momentum Score Guide.

Literal.Value: 'Momentum index calculation guide. The default score weights return rate at 35 percent, active-day consistency at 25 percent, prompt intensity at 25 percent, and advanced delegation at 15 percent.'
